messages:
maya: Quick Q — I'm putting together a short latency deep-dive focused on Dedicated GPU pools. Where's the canonical place to pull p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and tokens/sec for a given model+route? Also need a pointer to sample traces for the slow path.

jonathan: Grafana is the place for aggregated TTFT + percentile dashboards. Start with: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/latency/latency-overview — it has panels for p50/p95/p99 and a dropdown for 'deployment_type' where you can pick `dedicated`.

jonathan: For PromQL quick copies (use in Explore or panel queries):
```
# p95 request duration for inference routes (seconds)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",deployment="dedicated"}[5m])) by (le, model, route))

# tokens/sec emitted by model
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{deployment="dedicated"}[1m])) by (model, route)
```

jonathan: TTFT (time-to-first-token) panels use a separate metric `ttft_seconds_bucket` so swap `request_duration_seconds_bucket` -> `ttft_seconds_bucket` in the histogram_quantile above.

satish: if you're looking to correlate with traces, use Jaeger and the trace link panel in Grafana (click a slow request row -> open trace). Jaeger base: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/ search by trace id or service `inference-runtime`.

maya: Good — thanks. For the deep-dive I want to show an example of a slow sample (p99) and its span timeline. Any suggestions for filters to get representative traces instead of noise?

elaine: Filter for model+route and seq_len > 512 usually surfaces slow paths. In Jaeger you can search service=inference-runtime and tags:model=xx route=/v1/generate and then sort by duration. Also look for traces with `cache_miss=true` tag.

elaine: I can hand over 3 trace ids from yesterday's run that show the slow path: `9b1f3c25`, `4a7d2e6f`, `c2f9b001`. Paste into Jaeger: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/trace/9b1f3c25

maya: Perfect — can you also attach the matching Grafana screenshot or panel JSON so I can include it in the deck?

elaine: Yep, attaching panel JSON in the docs repo is easiest. See https://git.internal.redwood/infrastructure/observability/-/blob/main/dashboards/latency/dedicated-ttft-panel.json

jonathan: One more tip — use the tokens/sec heatmap on the same dashboard to show token emission vs latency. If tokens/sec spikes line up with higher p95/99, it's usually batching/queueing pressure.

satish: If you want to tune alerts: the alert config lives at https://git.internal.redwood/observability/alerts and the TTFT alert is `TTFT_P99_breach`. Default: fires if p99(ttft) > 1.2s for 5m. We can lower to 1.0s or add `for: 10m` to reduce flapping. Ping me for a PR.

maya: Great. Action items for me: 1) grab p50/p95/p99 panels + tokens heatmap, 2) include two Jaeger traces (elaine's), 3) propose a small alert tweak and open PR.

obs-bot: [automated] Alert suppression noted: TTFT_P99_breach suppressed for team-eng-platform during deck prep window.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll post the deck link once done and tag for review.
